name: fabnix
description: FABNIX — multi-tenant bilingual fabric shop management SaaS + online storefront

scripts.build: npm run build -w @fabnix/shared && npm run build -w @fabnix/backend && npm run build -w @fabnix/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @fabnix/shared && npm run test -w @fabnix/backend && npm run test -w @fabnix/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @fabnix/shared && npm run typecheck -w @fabnix/backend && npm run typecheck -w @fabnix/web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w @fabnix/backend && npm run build -w @fabnix/web && npm run test:e2e -w @fabnix/web
